listing.name: God of War III Remastered (gow3_pc)
listing.summary: Attach a prepared SpartanPort Windows installation for your independently permitted God of War III Remastered PS4 dump. The current Rust launcher owns upstream preparation; keep its saved settings, user data and legacy gow3 migration roots.

steps.title: Prepare the PS4 Remastered edition upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete copy and components you are independently permitted to use. The reviewed Windows3.0.0 route targets God of War III Remastered for PS4, CUSA01623 or CUSA01715 at01.00/01.02, with your own decrypted eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys folder. The original PS3 game is a different input. Follow upstream first setup outside Portcove, choose the actual game/update folders and save the intended configuration. No original, patch, installer, helper or build is obtained or run here.

steps.title: Keep the current complete Windows package
steps.instruction: The inspected spartanport-windows.zip contains spartanport-windows/SpartanPort.exe, Play SpartanPort.exe, compatibility-name launchers and bin/spartanport-probe.exe with matching DLLs and resources. Keep the entire package together in a writable folder. The current source is a Rust launcher/runner; do not apply older Python-only launch coordinates or select a compatibility shim, GPU helper, internal probe, DLL or PS4 eboot.bin. Upstream specifies Windows 10/11 x64, AVX and Vulkan1.3; static PE inspection does not verify a particular CPU/GPU.

steps.title: Select the saved-settings play route
steps.instruction: After upstream preparation, select SpartanPort.exe, use its complete extracted spartanport-windows directory as working directory and set the single argument --play. Review the exact selected intent, then request Play separately. With a valid saved installation this runs its --run child and waits for the native game/probe result; missing setup opens the GUI instead. Finish that setup outside the attached attempt before retrying. No observed child cleanup, Windows gameplay or dynamic dependency pass is claimed here.

steps.title: Preserve current and legacy data roots
steps.instruction: The current ordinary Windows package stores settings.json and spartanport.ini beside the launcher, with user holding saves, shader cache and last_run.log. A saved user_dir or established SPARTAN_DATA_DIR, SPARTAN_USER_DIR or SPARTAN_CONFIG can select other roots; preserve every effective location without setting a new override here. Also retain any existing gow3.ini, old %APPDATA%/gow3-launcher/settings.json, original game/update folders and custom saves. Do not assume the earlier gow3 name, framework ancestry or another PS4 title implies save compatibility.

steps.title: Complete upstream migration and restarts separately
steps.instruction: The rename/migration code can copy old settings to new names and retains old files; that is upstream behavior, not a migration performed by this attachment. Finish migration, updater replacement, voice tools, edition/config changes that restart the game, and repairs outside an attached session. Close the actual game and all helpers/successors, retain independent recovery copies, then review/relink changed executable bytes. Normal game exit is preferred; forced termination is not proof of save flush or child quiescence.

steps.title: Keep ownership and qualification explicit
steps.instruction: SpartanPort/gow3_pc is this existing God of War implementation; Bloodborne ancestry names a shared framework, not a replacement original-game identity or inherited qualification. Preserve GPL and all bundled component/NVIDIA notices; their grants do not provide original-game rights. Experimental Linux/old-CPU and GPU limitations remain upstream claims at their own scope. Removing registration preserves every external file. Portcove offers no managed install/update/rollback/backup/deletion or Supported/native/installed-app acceptance for this external copy.

warnings: Retain package settings, the actual user/save root and legacy gow3 data; complete upstream migrations, updates and restart paths outside attachment.
